SEARCH
Package parser

Class SceneXMLParser

java.lang.Object
parser.SceneXMLParser
public class SceneXMLParser extends Object
A parser for reading and initializing a SceneDescriptor object from an XML file. This class uses the SceneDescriptor.InitializeFromXMLstring(String) method to parse the XML file and populate the scene data.

  • Method Details

    • initializeFromXML

      public void initializeFromXML(String xmlFilePath) throws ParserConfigurationException, SAXException, IOException
      Initializes the SceneDescriptor by parsing the specified XML file. The parsed data will then be accessible via getData().
      Parameters:
      xmlFilePath - The path to the XML file to be parsed.
      Throws:
      ParserConfigurationException - if a parser cannot be created which satisfies the requested configuration.
      SAXException - if any SAX errors occur during parsing.
      IOException - if any I/O errors occur (e.g., file not found).

    • getData

      public SceneDescriptor getData()
      Gets the SceneDescriptor containing the parsed scene data. This method should be called after initializeFromXML(String) has been successfully executed.
      Returns:
      The SceneDescriptor object populated with scene data, or null if parsing failed or hasn't occurred.

    • main

      public static void main(String[] args)
      Main method for testing the XML parsing functionality. This method parses a sample XML file and prints the parsed scene data to the console.
      Parameters:
      args - Command-line arguments (not used).
